Cc: procurement@novaforge.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding - PO number missing & spend cap lower than discussed

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We started the vendor intake in your portal but ran into two blockers on our side:

1) The PO number referenced in your intake confirmation email doesn't appear to be attached to our account in your billing system — we received a confirmation email, but it shows "PO: TBD" when we try to match invoices.
2) The spend cap that your team provisioned is $18,000 for the month; during the call we'd agreed on a $45,000 provisional cap while we finish SOC evidence exchange.

We need the PO issued and the spend cap adjusted so we don't hit throttles next week. Also one of the SKU line items (NW-API-1) was split into two small lines during intake and the quantities got halved — can someone reattach the original SKU and correct quantities?

I've attached our signed vendor packet and the PO request spreadsheet. If easier, loop in your procurement lead and I can send a short list of invoice examples that fail reconciliation.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, NovaForge
liam@novaforge.com
+1 415-555-0193

Hi Liam —

Really sorry for the friction here and thanks for the level of detail. Quick plan from our side:

- Monica (cc'd) owns PO issuance and will create a provisional PO and temporary spend cap while we validate SOC docs.
- Karthik will look at the SKU mapping and re-link NW-API-1 to the original line and restore quantities.
- I'll monitor the issuance and confirm the PO number and updated limits by tomorrow EOD.

Can you confirm the exact invoice IDs that failed reconciliation (a couple of examples is fine) so Monica can cross-check ledger traces? If it's easier, share them directly to monica_patel@redwood.com.

I'll follow up with an internal ticket number once Monica opens the PO request.

Best,

I've opened PO ticket RED-PO-371 and allocated a provisional PO number: PO-20270217-371 (provisional). That PO is linked to your merchant profile but remains in "provisional" state pending SOC evidence ingestion. Quick notes:

- Provisional spend cap set to $50,000 for the next 30 days (temporary increase from the $18,000 state). This is a soft limit — we'll monitor usage and alert you at 80% consumption.
- SKU mapping: Karthik validated the intake log and reattached NW-API-1 to the primary SKU line; quantities reverted to original totals (QTY 100). You should see the corrected line in the portal by 09:30 PT.
- I've attached the PO request export for your records and included a short ledger trace id (LED-88-20270217) you can reference when submitting invoices.

Next steps for you:
1) Confirm two example invoice IDs that failed reconciliation so I can trace them against LED-88-20270217.
2) Sign the provisional PO via DocuSign (link below) so we can finalize the number and remove the provisional flag. If there are further line changes we can process a controlled amendment rather than recreating a new PO.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/XYZ-PO-371
Drive (PO export): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleOnboard
